init_distributed_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with NCCL backend and GPU streams for gradient sync
suppress_print_output: suppress all print output in non-master workers during distributed training
force_print_across_workers: force print output from any worker with device info in distributed training
compute_dataset_shard_range: compute the start and end indices for a dataset shard given rank and world size
review_distributed_utils: review the distributed training utilities for process group init, output suppression, and data sharding
